# Login to Spotify once, then fetch the full song library (pagination)
spotify_username = 'glenn.burton@gmail.com'
spotify_password = 'EbhXe%D'
spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_username, password=spotify_password)

spotify_token = spotify_login.get('access_token')

songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    # page is expected to be a list of songs
    songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total_songs', len(songs))
print('first_ids', [s.get('song_id') for s in songs[:5]])

arguments.code:
# Using previously logged-in spotify_token and fetched songs list from earlier blocks

play_stats = []
for s in songs:
    song_id = s.get('song_id')
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    play_stats.append({
        'song_id': song_id,
        'title': details.get('title'),
        'play_count': details.get('play_count')
    })

# Sort by play_count ascending; if tie, then by title for deterministic selection
play_stats_sorted = sorted(play_stats, key=lambda x: (x['play_count'], x['title']))
print('total_lib_songs', len(play_stats_sorted))
print('sorted_by_play_count_top10', play_stats_sorted[:10])
least_played = play_stats_sorted[0] if play_stats_sorted else None
print('least_played', least_played)
least_played_title = least_played['title'] if least_played else None
print('least_played_title', least_played_title)
